technical.summary: COST shows solid bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but elevated overbought conditions (RSI-21, Williams %R, Stoch K) and below-average volume ratio limit entry conviction on 2022-07-28.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (333), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, FOMC event just passed, and earnings binary 69 days out create hostile trading environment for COST.
